XOLOTL.NAME: Xolotl
XOLOTL.LR: God of monsters and deformities. Focus: Myth units.
XOLOTL.SELF: You have advanced to the Mythic Age through the misfortune of Xolotl!
XOLOTL.OTHER: {0} advances to the Mythic Age through the misfortune of Xolotl.

WINGS_OF_THE_SOUTH.NAME: Wings of the South
WINGS_OF_THE_SOUTH.LR: Huitzilopochtli increases the movement speed and training rate of all War Hut units.

TEPEYOLLOTLS_REACH.NAME: Tepeyollotl's Reach
TEPEYOLLOTLS_REACH.LR: Tezcatlipoca increases the damage and jump distance of Ocelotl Warriors and Jaguar Riders.

FEAST_OF_TLAXOCHIMACO.NAME: Feast of Sustenance
FEAST_OF_TLAXOCHIMACO.LR: Quetzalcoatl enables livestock to be devoted at the Temple to temporarily increase the gather rate of all villagers.
FEAST_OF_TLAXOCHIMACO.NOTIFICATION: You are celebrating the Feast of Sustenance.
FEAST_OF_TLAXOCHIMACO.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Herdable: Can now be Devoted at the temple, for a +15% increase in all gather rates, for 15 seconds.

FEAST_OF_TLAXOCHIMACO_ACTIVE.LR: +15% increase in all gather rates, for 15 seconds.

OMETOCHTLIS_REVELRY.NAME: Ometochtli's Revelry
OMETOCHTLIS_REVELRY.LR: Patecatl upgrades Centzon Totochthin to Frenzied Centzon Totochthin, which have more hitpoints and consume farms and berry bushes faster to heal.

OCPATLI_INFUSIONS.NAME: Ocpatli Infusions
OCPATLI_INFUSIONS.LR: Patecatl reveals the medicinal secrets of Ocpatli roots, fortifying Settlers and human soldiers with regeneration and increased hitpoints.

MAGUEY_CULTIVATION.NAME: Maguey Cultivation
MAGUEY_CULTIVATION.LR: Patecatl introduces maguey cultivation, increasing Settler farming rates and granting a Food bounty when Farms are constructed.

OMEN_OF_MALINALCO.NAME: Omen of Malinalco
OMEN_OF_MALINALCO.LR: Malinalxochitl causes Maquizcoatls to release a poisonous cloud on death that damages nearby enemies and corrodes their armor, making them more vulnerable to attacks.
OMEN_OF_MALINALCO.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Maquizcoatl: On death: deal 10 Divine damage in 4 radius.\n • Maquizcoatl: On death: Reduce enemy Hack & Pierce armor by -20% in 4 radius. \n • Maquizcoatl: On death: Deal 1.5 Divine Damage per second, for 6 seconds to enemies in 4 radius

STING_OF_YAPPAN.NAME: Sting of Yappan
STING_OF_YAPPAN.LR: Malinalxochitl grants your War Hut soldiers the sting of the scorpion, causing their attacks to inflict poison damage over time.
STING_OF_YAPPAN.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE1: Tlamanih Spearman: Add 0.1 Divine damage over time towards Unit (Excluding Siege) for 6.0 seconds
STING_OF_YAPPAN.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE2: Tequihua Archer: Add 0.1 Divine damage over time towards Unit (Excluding Siege) for 6.0 seconds

TOLOACHE_TRANCE.NAME: Toloache Trance
TOLOACHE_TRANCE.LR: Malinalxochitl imbues your warriors' weapons with the effects of toloache, numbing the minds of enemies with every strike, slowing their attack speed.
TOLOACHE_TRANCE.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Human Soldier: Reduce Unit (Excluding Siege) attack speed by 2% for 5.0 seconds, stacking

OLD_COYOTES_SPIRIT.NAME: Old Coyote's Spirit
OLD_COYOTES_SPIRIT.LR: Huehuecóyotl inspires Chaneques to get the last laugh, increasing their hack armor and giving them a chance to spawn a trap when defeated.

CUICACALLI_TRAINING.NAME: Cuicacalli Training
CUICACALLI_TRAINING.LR: Huehuecóyotl choreographs Coyote Warriors to move with unpredictable steps, improving their pierce armor.

TEPONAZTLI_DRUMS.NAME: Teponaztli Drums
TEPONAZTLI_DRUMS.LR: Huehuecóyotl increases the speed of your villagers, human soldiers, and heroes.

NAHUALLATOLLI.NAME: Nahuallatolli
NAHUALLATOLLI.LR: Huehuecóyotl reduces the cost of your traps, and increases their build limit.

SERPENT_SKIRT.NAME: Serpent Skirt
SERPENT_SKIRT.LR: Coatlicue summons Anacondas from your destroyed buildings, to defend the area temporarily.

COATEPEC_SHRINES.NAME: Coatepec Shrines
COATEPEC_SHRINES.LR: Coatlicue removes the cost of repairing buildings and allows them to regenerate hitpoints.

STRING_OF_HEARTS.NAME: String of Hearts
STRING_OF_HEARTS.LR: Coatlicue's necklace of dismembered hands and hearts compels human soldiers to inflict damage, especially crush, making them more effective against buildings.

CIPACTLIS_SCALES.NAME: Cipactli’s Scales
CIPACTLIS_SCALES.LR: Coatlicue increases the armor of Atlatl Siege Canoes as they lose hitpoints.

CENTZON_HUITZNAHUA.NAME: Centzon Huitznahua
CENTZON_HUITZNAHUA.LR: Coyolxauhqui upgrades Tzitzimitls to Stardemon Tzitzimitls, which deal more damage and attack faster.

COYOLXAUHQUI_STONE.NAME: Coyolxauhqui's Stone
COYOLXAUHQUI_STONE.LR: Coyolxauhqui reduces the resource cost of upgrades researched at the Temple and Great Temple.

TECCIZTECATLS_PENANCE.NAME: Tecciztécatl's Penance
TECCIZTECATLS_PENANCE.LR: Coyolxauhqui increases the Favor earned by devoting Settlers.

METZLIAPAN.NAME: Metzliapán
METZLIAPAN.LR: Coyolxauhqui reduces the Favor cost Axolotls and Mutant Axolotls, and allows them to use their special attacks more often.

WINGS_OF_ITZPAPALOTL.NAME: Wings of Itzpapalotl
WINGS_OF_ITZPAPALOTL.LR: Itzpapalotl sharpens the wings of your Obsidian Butterflies, increasing their movement speed, bleed and special attack damage.

OBSIDIAN_KNAPPING.NAME: Obsidian Knapping
OBSIDIAN_KNAPPING.LR: Itzpapalotl teaches the art of obsidian knapping, increasing the attack of units trained at the Nobles' Hut.

FLOWERY_WARS.NAME: Flowery Wars
FLOWERY_WARS.LR: Itzpapalotl's hunger for tribute increases the Favor earned from gathering tonalli of fallen foes.

SHARDS_OF_ITZTLI.NAME: Shards of Itztli
SHARDS_OF_ITZTLI.LR: Itzpapalotl studs Arrow Canoes with her obsidian, increasing their attack.

BURNT_WATER.NAME: Burnt Water
BURNT_WATER.LR: Tlaloc strengthens your fortifications, increasing their hitpoints and allowing them to attack units beneath them with sacred fire-water.

TLALOQUES.NAME: Tlaloques
TLALOQUES.LR: Tlaloc sends the Tlaloques to assist your people, significantly reducing the cost and research time of Calpulli improvements, and granting 75 gold for each Calpulli research completed.

TONACATEPETL.NAME: Tonacatépetl
TONACATEPETL.LR: Tlaloc’s mountain of sustenance inspires Settlers near Livestock Pens to gather food faster, especially from animals.
TONACATEPETL.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE1: Calpulli (Livestock Pen): Villagers gather work rate +15% from Farm
TONACATEPETL.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE2: Calpulli (Livestock Pen): Villagers gather work rate +50% from Huntables \n • Calpulli (Livestock Pen): Villagers gather work rate +50% from Herdables

FOUR_JARS.NAME: Four Jars
FOUR_JARS.LR: Tlaloc pours abundance from his jars, reducing the cost of Great Temples and allowing them to support population.

EVENING_STAR.NAME: Evening Star
EVENING_STAR.LR: Xolotl grants a free Soul Guide for each of your existing Great Temples, and whenever a new one is completed.
EVENING_STAR.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Great Temple: Summon 1 Soul Guide for each current and future Great Temple completed

STONESKIN_QUINAMETZIN.NAME: Stoneskin Quinametzin
STONESKIN_QUINAMETZIN.LR: Xolotl upgrades Quinametzin to Stoneskin Quinametzin, which have more range, attack, and hitpoints.

TWISTED_LIMBS.NAME: Twisted Limbs
TWISTED_LIMBS.LR: Xolotl contorts the bodies of Ocelotl Warriors, allowing their Leap ability to deal more damage and increasing their hitpoints.

TORCH_OF_MISFORTUNE.NAME: Torch of Misfortune
TORCH_OF_MISFORTUNE.LR: Xolotl upgrades Soul Guides to Soul Masters, which can use chain lightning attacks.

NECKLACE_OF_EYEBALLS.NAME: Necklace of Eyeballs
NECKLACE_OF_EYEBALLS.LR: Mictlantecuhtli adorns your Heroes with a Necklace of Eyeballs, increasing their attack, hitpoints, and line of sight.

OMEN_OF_DEATH.NAME: Omen of Death
OMEN_OF_DEATH.LR: Mictlantecuhtli causes Teixiptlas to call down a strike from the heavens when defeated, damaging nearby enemies.
OMEN_OF_DEATH.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Teixiptla: On Death: Inflict 50 Hack damage and Throw enemies, in 5 radius

PRECIOUS_BONES.NAME: Precious Bones
PRECIOUS_BONES.LR: Mictlantecuhtli empowers your ranged soldiers, which increase their damage and compensates you with wood they fall in battle.

MICTECAH.NAME: Mictecah
MICTECAH.LR: Mictlantecuhtli imbues Shorn Ones with the chill of the underworld, enabling them to slay enemies more quickly, especially heroes.

MEDIUM_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Medium War Hut Soldiers
MEDIUM_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades War Hut Soldiers to Medium War Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

HEAVY_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Heavy War Hut Soldiers
HEAVY_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Medium War Hut Soldiers to Heavy War Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

CHAMPION_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Champion War Hut Soldiers
CHAMPION_WAR_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Heavy War Hut Soldiers to Champion War Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

ADVANCED_TRAPS.NAME: Advanced Traps
ADVANCED_TRAPS.LR: Upgrade your Spike traps to Obsidian Spike Traps with increased damage, and Smoke traps to Chilli Bomb Traps, which have greater blinding and slowing effect.
ADVANCED_TRAPS.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE1: Smoke Trap: Enemy vision reduced from -60% to -80%
ADVANCED_TRAPS.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE2: Smoke Trap: Enemy Unit movement speed reduction increased from -20% to -40%

MEDIUM_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Medium Noble's Hut Soldiers
MEDIUM_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Noble's Hut Soldiers to Medium Noble's Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

HEAVY_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Heavy Noble's Hut Soldiers
HEAVY_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Medium Noble's Hut Soldiers to Heavy Noble's Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

CHAMPION_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.NAME: Champion Noble's Hut Soldiers
CHAMPION_NOBLES_HUT_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Heavy Noble's Hut Soldiers to Champion Noble's Hut Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

MEDIUM_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.NAME: Medium Great Temple Soldiers
MEDIUM_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Great Temple Soldiers to Medium Great Temple Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

HEAVY_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.NAME: Heavy Great Temple Soldiers
HEAVY_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Medium Great Temple Soldiers to Heavy Great Temple Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

CHAMPION_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.NAME: Champion Great Temple Soldiers
CHAMPION_GREAT_TEMPLE_SOLDIERS.LR: Upgrades Heavy Great Temple Soldiers to Champion Great Temple Soldiers, with more hitpoints and attack.

FLINT_WEAPONS.NAME: Flint Weapons
FLINT_WEAPONS.LR: Flint Weapons improve the attack of all human soldiers, heroes, ships, and buildings.

JADE_WEAPONS.NAME: Jade Weapons
JADE_WEAPONS.LR: Jade Weapons improve the attack of all human soldiers, heroes, ships, and buildings.

OBSIDIAN_WEAPONS.NAME: Obsidian Weapons
OBSIDIAN_WEAPONS.LR: Obsidian Weapons improve the attack of all human soldiers, heroes, ships, and buildings.

FEATHERED_ARMOR.NAME: Feathered Armor
FEATHERED_ARMOR.LR: Feathered Armor improves human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to hack attacks, such as swords. It also makes ships more resistant to crush attacks, such as siege weapons.

CEREMONIAL_ARMOR.NAME: Ceremonial Armor
CEREMONIAL_ARMOR.LR: Ceremonial Armor improves human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to hack attacks, such as swords. It also makes ships more resistant to crush attacks, such as siege weapons.

SACRED_ARMOR.NAME: Sacred Armor
SACRED_ARMOR.LR: Sacred Armor improves human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to hack attacks, such as swords. It also makes ships more resistant to crush attacks, such as siege weapons.

FEATHERED_SHIELDS.NAME: Feathered Shields
FEATHERED_SHIELDS.LR: Feathered Shields improve human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to pierce attacks, such as arrows.

CEREMONIAL_SHIELDS.NAME: Ceremonial Shields
CEREMONIAL_SHIELDS.LR: Ceremonial Shields improve human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to pierce attacks, such as arrows.

SACRED_SHIELDS.NAME: Sacred Shields
SACRED_SHIELDS.LR: Sacred Shields improve human soldier, hero, and ship resistance to pierce attacks, such as arrows.

AMBUSH.NAME: Ambush Tactics
AMBUSH.LR: Ambush Tactics upgrade increases Infantry and Cavalry attacking range.

CHINAMPAS.NAME: Chinampas
CHINAMPAS.LR: Upgrades Farms into Chinampas, which enables Villagers to gather Food from them faster.

TZOMPANTLI_WATCH_TOWER.NAME: Tzompantli Watch Tower
TZOMPANTLI_WATCH_TOWER.LR: Upgrades Tzompantli Towers into Tzompantli Watch Towers, adding an attack that slows enemies.

TEMIMINALOYAN_TRIALS.NAME: Temiminaloyan Trials
TEMIMINALOYAN_TRIALS.LR: Upgrades Tzompantli Watch Towers allowing them shoot an additional projectile, and increasing the amount of slow inflicted.
TEMIMINALOYAN_TRIALS.TECH_EFFECT_OVERRIDE: Tzompantli Tower: Adds 1 to Ranged Attack Number of Projectiles

WARRIORS_HONOR.NAME: Warrior’s Honor
WARRIORS_HONOR.LR: When a unit is killed, it creates a single tonalli drop that benefits favor generation. Tonalli dropped from your own fallen units are instantly applied without needing to be collected. However, tonalli dropped from enemy units must be collected from a Warrior Priests unit.

SACRIFICE_SETTLER.NAME: Sacrifice Settlers
SACRIFICE_SETTLER.LR: Sacrifice Settlers to earn Favor from the gods. The earlier the Age, the more Favor is bestowed.

SACRIFICE_LIVESTOCK.NAME: Livestock Head
SACRIFICE_LIVESTOCK.LR: Sacrifice livestock for a small gather rate buff to all resources.

NEW_FIRE_CEREMONY.LR: Garrison 3 Livestock at the Great Temple and use this command to Devote them.\nReward: For 60 seconds, Devoting Settlers earns more Favor and livestock fatten faster.

COSMIC_GUARD.LR: Garrison 12 non-scout human soldiers at the Great Temple and use this command to Devote them.\nReward: Spawns 4 myth units (2 from Age IV and 2 from Age III).

ARRIVAL_OF_THE_GODS.LR: Garrison 6 warrior priests at the Great Temple and use this command to Devote them.\nReward: Incarnates your major god as a special teixiptla with greatly increased lifespan and combat stats.
